title: Media Inquiry — Channel 5 News

fields.message: We are going live in 15 minutes. Passengers are filming Flight 666 on the FIDS. We have photos of fake gates and a board listing 'Purgatory'. This is now 'Cyber Terror'. We need a statement from NCIA. Go live or we run with it.
fields.deadline: GOING LIVE IN 15 MINUTES — STATEMENT REQUIRED

instructorNote: This inject pressures the PIO to issue a public holding statement under media deadline. Watch for premature confirmation of cyber incident or unverified details.
